natural_body: Price-sensitive SMB 40% off: signups +31%, rev +18%, retention -12%.

first.rationale: Verify the two archived onboarding and signup-simplification results because onboarding completion and activation are both declining. A guarded onboarding simplification is more aligned with sustainable qualified revenue than aggressive discounting, which previously increased revenue but reduced retention. The experiment should measure completion, activation, qualified pipeline or revenue, and downstream retention rather than optimizing completion alone.
